description: Status of a depth shell started with pano_scene_create. Returns status and progress while it runs; when done, glb_url (the depth shell mesh), ply_url (point cloud) and viewer_url. When it failed, a readable reason. It never starts or repeats work, so poll about every 20 seconds. Use this when a pano_scene_create job_id needs its current state or finished files.

job_id.description: The job_id the start tool returned.

name: pano_scene_status
title: Get a depth shell job
